title: Best Tidio Alternatives
intro: Tidio's Lyro AI agent reportedly resolves around 90% of conversations with minimal hallucination — a genuinely strong signal — but pricing transparency (unexpected plan upgrades, refund friction) is the most-repeated complaint across its reviews, and its channel coverage stops short of WhatsApp or voice. Here's what to consider instead.

entries.blurb: A comparably fast-to-launch AI chatbot builder with broader channel reach (adds voice/telephony from the Standard tier) once you're past the credit-metered pricing quirks of both platforms.
If Tidio's missing WhatsApp coverage is the dealbreaker, Crisp bundles web chat, WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger into one inbox from $45/mo.
